notes.title: DevLog #01: Visual Details and Partial Art Optimization
notes.notes:
Today, we’re sharing the update log for our Demo with everyone!
Those who have played both versions of the Demo should have noticed that we’ve made a lot of changes.
During the early stages of development, we focused on the core gameplay—puzzle design, and the arrangement of the scenes was mostly centered around the puzzles.
After receiving feedback from everyone who tried out the game during the New Game Festival, we’ve made significant revisions!

Add the game to your wishlist or try out the free DEMO:
https://store.steampowered.com/app/2499570

🧸 Based on the storyline—We’ve added more room decorations! (We’ve given Coal a lot of new toys! Coal (Cat's name) is overjoyed!)
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44412743/dfa999dab7aea2bec6715c18b466f88607fca70e.png[/img]

🪀 Further beautification of small items!—We’ve changed the original lines and added more cute styles to the scenes! (We’ve been constantly tweaking the color combinations)
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44412743/78c92469644f831fdbc0ee85ce7f222ab7d447a2.png[/img]

🖼️ We’ve also made many adjustments to the textures of the scene items—Have any attentive players noticed the changes in the brush texture? Every stroke is hand-drawn with care.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44412743/ea0f895af8456e642e28e20f972cfca2554be95a.png[/img]

[h3]For more details, check out our video[/h3]
https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=o4s7cJQwkmo

[h3]Game Overview:[/h3]
From the moment Orange the cat wakes up from a coma, its life is completely rewritten. Upon entering this mysterious villa, Orange encounters the bizarre disappearance of the homeowner, "Boss." The animal companions living under the same roof, each with distinct personalities, can all speak and clearly possess wisdom beyond that of ordinary animals.

"Wait, how did I become so smart too?"
Life as a smart cat is not that simple. In the game, you will collaborate with other animal friends, gather clues, use your nimble paws to climb up and down the rooms, and employ the sharp mind of a cat to solve puzzles and explore the secrets and truths hidden in every corner.

notes.title: Cat at Home Japanese Version Confirmation!
notes.notes:
Dear Little Master/Mistress,

We are thrilled to officially announce that the Japanese localization has now been added to Cat at Home DEMO. We warmly welcome everyone to come and experience it!

Join forces with the cat to use your wisdom to resolve crises at home and embark on this adventure together.

Additionally, the full version of Cat at Home will fully support Japanese. We understand that there are differences in language habits and culture across regions. If you encounter any issues while playing the Japanese version, please feel free to provide feedback to us through the STEAM community or this announcement.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44412743/4b2003299c0bc6f9f670a08520701069e4f81f39.jpg[/img]

notes.title: "Cat at Home" is now participating in the STEAM NEXTFEST! DEMO has been updated!
notes.notes:
Dear Players,

Thank you for your continuous support and attention to our game! We are excited to announce that Cat at Home will be participating in the Steam NEXTFEST from February 25th to March 4th. We warmly welcome you to join us and try out the game!🐱

This is a 2D side-scrolling story-puzzle game featuring a cat as the protagonist. The game takes place in a villa, where you play as a cat who has just entered a new home. You will meet various animal companions with different personalities, help each other, and solve puzzles together to resolve the crises in the house.🐦

In this DEMO update, we have revised many scenes and optimized some puzzles. We have ensured that you will experience a brand-new version of Cat at Home. Come and try it out!

If you encounter any issues during your playtest, or if you have any feedback or suggestions, please feel free to join our official Discord and share your thoughts with us.
🌞Discord: [url=https://discord.gg/zNzFPP8Xb48]https://discord.gg/zNzFPP8Xb48[/url]
